subject.title: feat(llama-cpp): RAM-gated Gemma 4 E4B default, drop Qwen

question: Should bundled llama.cpp onboarding replace Qwen with Gemma 4 and suppress the default download offer below an effective 16 GiB memory ceiling?
rationale: The model choice and removal of the low-memory offer are intentional provider-default policy changes; code review can verify safety but cannot select that permanent onboarding policy.

options.title: Adopt Gemma with safe gating
options.body: Keep the proposed direction after using the effective process memory limit and adding real setup and load proof.

options.title: Retain the current Qwen offer
options.body: Keep the smaller current default while gathering stronger llama.cpp-native model-quality and low-memory evidence.

options.title: Pause bundled defaults
options.body: Offer only cached or explicitly configured GGUF models until a hardware-aware default policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Adopt Gemma with safe gating
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed direction after using the effective process memory limit and adding real setup and load proof.
